NEW WAVE JIU JITSU OPEN GUARD VOL 1.overview: John Danaher's 'Open Guard: The Two Foundations of Guard Play', the first of his two no-gi open guard courses, eight volumes. The two foundations are guard retention and constant threat. Volume 1 covers key insights, connection and grips. Volume 2 covers dynamic push-pull laws (shoulders and hips, heels and toes, head under / head over). Volume 3 covers the elements of guard retention (demarcation, body movements, foot pummelling). Volume 4 applies retention against mobility passes and pressure passes (stack, body lock). Volume 5 covers the second foundation, constant threat, especially direct attacks on the legs. Volumes 6 to 8 cover leg entries: single, double and reverse double leg entries and the irimi ashi cross catch, X guard (triple attack, momentum entry) and reverse De La Riva, then De La Riva and closed guard entries.
key: Retention against mobility and pressure passes
Leg entries from X, RDLR, DLR and closed guard

NEW WAVE JIU JITSU OPEN GUARD VOL 2 - SW.overview: The second of John Danaher's no-gi open guard courses, eight volumes on sweeps and reversals. Volume 1 covers key insights. Volume 2 covers the reverse tripod sweep and wrestling reversals (ankle picks). Volume 3 covers the outside tripod sweep (irimi ashi garami sweep, double leg ashi). Volume 4 covers sumi gaeshi as the main attack on a kneeling opponent. Volume 5 covers upper body submissions (triangle, armbar, guillotine). Volume 6 covers guillotines (the football snap guillotine and others). Volume 7 covers go-behinds (the knee block go-behind). Volume 8 covers five dilemmas that will change your guard (push/pull and others).
key: Triangle, armbar and guillotine from guard
